title: Cap. IV Arg. 4 Sol close: love to eternal life in Christ true of introduction, false of praedestinatio
pass_a_gloss: But what Arminius urges, That God loves no one to eternal life except in Christ, that is, as he interprets, except considered as faithful, and already inserted into Christ, and therefore elects no one except as faithful; that is true of the introduction itself to eternal life, but false of predestination. For God in this sense loves to eternal life all those whom before the foundations of the world were laid he decreed to give to Christ to be made alive and saved. But these who are given to be made alive are not considered by God as made alive and faithful, but as dead in sins and still unbelieving. To finish in a word; God is said to have chosen us in Christ, not because he considered us as existing in Christ through our faith, before we were elected, but because with respect to Christ the Mediator whoever are predestinated are predestinated to eternal life.
pass_b_english: Arminius urges that God loves no one to eternal life except in Christ — as he reads it, except considered faithful and already inserted into Christ, and so elects none except as faithful. That is true of the introduction itself to eternal life, false of predestination. In that sense God loves to eternal life all he decreed before the world's foundations to give to Christ to be made alive and saved. Those given to be made alive are not considered already made alive and faithful, but dead in sins and still unbelieving. In a word: God chose us in Christ not because he viewed us as already in Christ by our faith before election, but because with respect to Christ the Mediator all who are predestinated are predestinated to eternal life.
source_text: Quod autem Arminius urget, Deum neminem amare ad vitam aeternam nisi in Christo, hoc est, ut ille interpretatur, nisi consideratum ut fidelem, et jam Christo insertum, ac proinde neminem eligere nisi qua fidelem; id de ipsa introductione ad vitam aeternam verum est, sed de praedestinatione falsum. Nam Deus illos omnes hoc sensu ad vitam aeternam amat, quos Christo vivificandos et servandos ante jacta mundi fundamenta dare decrevit. Hi autem qui dantur vivificandi, non considerantur a Deo ut vivificati et fideles, sed ut in peccatis mortui et adhuc infideles. Ut absolvam verbo; Deus dicitur nos elegisse in Christo, non quia consideravit nos tanquam per fidem nostram in Christo existentes, antequam eligeremur, sed quia cum respectu ad Christum Mediatorem ad vitam aeternam praedestinantur quotquot praedestinantur.
